ev.q: RoboCop: Rogue City is a 2023 first-person shooter game
The RoboCop franchise depicts a dystopian near-future Detroit
Impoverished and overrun with criminal activity
The overall storyline and ending are also altered depending on decisions made by the player
by selecting between different dialogue options
The player can buy different abilities with experience points gained by completing objectives
praised the graphics, stating that the game made great use of Unreal Engine 5
